g.title: ConferenceOCELCrosswalk
g.text: Conference domain model → OCEL 2.0 mapping overview
Domain concepts, target objects/events, attributes, and associations

g.title: objtypes
g.text: AdditionalAssignment instances reuse the Assignment object type through the subclass mapping; no separate OCEL object type is created.

g.title: eventnote
g.text: No separate Decide event is generated.
The accepts/rejects counts are not projected.
The final outcome is represented by NotifyDecision
and by the Paper.decision dynamic attribute.

g.title: linknote
g.text: corr carries eQualifier and links one Event
to one Object. relatedTo is an association
